rows.name: basal_area
rows.description: Current basal area of the coupled epithelial patch (grows under proliferation, resisted by the BM).

rows.name: basal_strain_rate
rows.description: Rate of change of the basal surface strain that drives the BM (the forward half of the coupling).

rows.name: bm_sigma
rows.description: Reduced-order BM reaction stress; zero when the BM is inert (uncoupled), non-zero when the epithelium drives it.

rows.name: basal_tension
rows.description: BM reaction fed back onto the cells as a basal tension; zero in one-way/uncoupled, non-zero in two-way (the reaction half).

rows.name: lumen_pressure
rows.description: Lumen pressure of the closed patch; responds to the coupled cell-shape/BM state.
